resolution.note: fast-check caches a PASS keyed by tree hash plus base

title: Reuse a cached npm run fast pass on an unchanged tree
body:
Outcome: a second `npm run fast` on an unchanged tree prints its cached PASS without rerunning checks.
Why: 575 fast runs over 129 PRs (4.5 per PR), 157 pass-after-pass; each run is a lead turn, 7.7% of lead dollars (.krn/runs/roadmap-refill-3/session-cost.md).
Proof: scripts/fast-check.ts stores a pass marker keyed by the tree hash (git write-tree with the working tree staged into a temp index) under .krn/cache; a test shows the second run is a cache hit and any edit invalidates it.
Scope: scripts/fast-check.ts and its test.
